description: Extract duplicated validation logic from three modules into a shared helper.
instruction: Three source files (`src/users.js`, `src/orders.js`, `src/products.js`) each contain their own copy of the same email-validation and ID-validation logic. Extract the shared validation functions into a new `src/validate.js` module and update all three callers to import from it. The extracted module must export `isValidEmail(str)` and `isValidId(str)`. Do not change any behavior — `node --test` must pass.
